assessment.nobel_worthiness: The experimental discovery of the Higgs boson completed a central part of the Standard Model and required an exceptional advance in collider physics.
assessment.attribution: These leaders represent the two experiments that independently established the discovery, though the result depended on very large international collaborations.
assessment.maturity: More than a decade of follow-up has strengthened the discovery and its interpretation.
uncertainties: Credit for a collaboration-scale result cannot be captured fully by a few individuals.
This experimental discovery is distinct from the earlier theoretical prediction of the Higgs mechanism.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP's precise map of the cosmic microwave background made precision cosmology possible and sharply constrained the composition and history of the Universe.
assessment.attribution: The named scientists represent the mission's observational leadership and key cosmological interpretation; the result was produced by a large team.
assessment.maturity: The measurements have been extensively checked and form a durable foundation for later cosmological work.
uncertainties: The contribution of WMAP relative to earlier and later CMB experiments needs careful delineation.
Mission-wide credit is difficult to assign to a small number of people.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gauge-gravity holography has profoundly shaped theoretical physics by relating quantum field theories to gravitational descriptions in higher dimensions.
assessment.attribution: Maldacena's proposal established the central duality, while Witten's work helped develop and clarify its broader framework.
assessment.maturity: The duality has generated extensive, durable results across theory, although its physical scope remains under active study.
uncertainties: The proposed correspondence is not a direct experimental discovery of quantum gravity.
The relative credit for the original insight and subsequent development requires careful assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Event Horizon Telescope produced compelling images of black holes and opened a new observational route to testing gravity in extreme conditions.
assessment.attribution: These names represent key contributions to the observing effort and the theoretical interpretation; the images depended on a large international network and team.
assessment.maturity: The central results have been published and supported by further observations, with substantial scope for continued tests.
uncertainties: The observations resolve emission around a black hole rather than the event horizon itself.
Credit for the array, algorithms, and collaboration-wide work is necessarily incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The observation of a neutron-star merger and its kilonova connected gravitational waves, electromagnetic astronomy, and the production of heavy elements in a striking multi-messenger result.
assessment.attribution: These scientists made influential contributions to the predicted and observed kilonova signal, though the discovery rested on many observatories and teams.
assessment.maturity: The merger and kilonova interpretation are well established, while the precise contribution of such events to the cosmic inventory of heavy elements remains an active question.
uncertainties: The extent to which neutron-star mergers account for the full r-process abundance is still uncertain.
The candidate names do not encompass the many experimental teams central to the observation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Self-amplified spontaneous emission enabled X-ray free-electron lasers to deliver intense, ultrashort pulses, creating a powerful new way to study matter.
assessment.attribution: The credited theorists and accelerator physicists made central contributions to the concept and its development; building working facilities required major international teams.
assessment.maturity: The technology has operated at multiple facilities and produced a broad body of scientific results.
uncertainties: The boundary between the key invention and the many later engineering advances needs careful attribution.
The most decisive contributions among the credited names may not be equivalent.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube established high-energy neutrino astronomy and opened a new observational window on energetic astrophysical sources.
assessment.attribution: These scientists represent major leadership and detector contributions, while discovery and source identification depended on the full collaboration and partner observatories.
assessment.maturity: The neutrino signal is firmly established and has been followed by evidence linking neutrinos to astrophysical sources.
uncertainties: The origins of the high-energy neutrino population are not yet fully identified.
The detector and discovery were collective achievements involving many contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks transformed precision measurement and enabled stringent tests of fundamental physics as well as new applications in timekeeping.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye made seminal, complementary contributions to the clock concepts and their experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The technology has been repeatedly demonstrated and improved, with the field still advancing rapidly.
uncertainties: The distinction between foundational clock advances and subsequent improvements by other groups should be assessed.
The full impact on fundamental physics may take longer to establish.
